title: Discounted Purchase Regret Rate
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), cashback events (`cashback:event`), price tracker alerts (`pricetrack:alert`), and tip logs (`tiplog:shift`).
app: Micro-finance telemetry for latte-factor spending, cashback apps, price tracking, and tip logging sent to Splunk HEC via finance exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=microspend:txn
| search discounted=true regretted=true
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as regretted_buys avg(discount_pct) as avg_discount_pct by _time category
| sort - _time
description: Tracks regretted discounted purchases over time and breaks it out by category.
value: Discounted regret shows whether sales are helping you save or simply accelerating low-value purchases.
implementation: Send regretted discounted purchases events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of regretted discounted purchases by category.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how regretted discounted purchases changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
